commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the T3 Code server without opening a browser and print headless pairing details.

commands.name: app
commands.description: Open a project in the running T3 Code desktop app.

commands.name: pair
commands.description: Mint a pairing token for a running T3 Code server and print it as a QR code.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Manage the local auth control plane for headless deployments.

commands.name: browser
commands.description: Manage T3's headless browser on this host.

commands.name: service
commands.description: Manage the T3 Code background service.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Download a newer t3 and switch this machine to it, including the background service when one is installed.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Remove t3 from this machine: the background service, the launcher, and every downloaded version. Your projects and threads are kept.

commands.name: theme
commands.description: Inspect and set environment-wide theme defaults.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Inspect the local server trace file.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Inspect this T3 Code data directory and repair it. Pauses and restarts the background service as needed.

commands.name: triage
commands.description: Investigate a T3 Code problem on this machine with claude or codex, and help file a good issue.

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Set up T3 Connect for this machine.
